context: Evaluates whether the agent goes beyond a caller list for a dependency bump, routes in-repo lookups through tokensave, and cites only what was actually found.

checklist.name: not_stopping_at_caller_list
checklist.description: The response goes beyond listing direct callers into what a caller sweep can't show (format changes, downstream consumers, version-specific behavior).

checklist.name: tokensave_first_for_in_repo_source
checklist.description: Lookups of in-repo code (vendored copies, local patches) are attributed to tokensave tools, with raw Read reserved for source genuinely outside the repo's graph.

checklist.name: downstream_effects_considered
checklist.description: The response considers what reads the validator's output/wire shape several hops downstream, not just direct callers.

checklist.name: real_citations_no_invention
checklist.description: Every named caller, API, or behavior change was actually located by a described search; a null search is reported honestly rather than omitted or guessed.
